4:80.text: , has indeed obeyed Allâh, but he who turns away, then we have not sent you

4:81.text: They say: "We are obedient," but when they leave you
, a section of them spend all night in planning other than what you say. But Allâh records their nightly
, and put your trust in Allâh. And Allâh is Ever All-Sufficient as a Disposer of affairs.

4:82.text: Do they not then consider the Qur’ân carefully? Had it been from other than Allâh, they would surely have found therein many a contradiction.

4:83.text: When there comes to them some matter touching
safety or fear, they make it known
; if only they had referred it to the Messenger or to those charged with authority among them, the proper investigators would have understood it from them
. Had it not been for the Grace and Mercy of Allâh upon you, you would have followed Shaitân

4:84.text: in the Cause of Allâh, you are not tasked
except for yourself, and incite the believers
, it may be that Allâh will restrain the evil might of the disbelievers. And Allâh is Stronger in Might and Stronger in punishing.

4:85.text: Whosoever intercedes for a good cause will have the reward thereof, and whosoever intercedes for an evil cause will have a share in its burden. And Allâh is Ever All-Able to do

4:86.text: When you are greeted with a greeting, greet in return with what is better than it, or
return it equally. Certainly, Allâh is Ever a Careful Account Taker of all things.
